articles.summary: Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. (the “Company”) (NYSE: MCB), the holding company for Metropolitan Commercial Bank, today announced it will release third quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Tuesday, October 20, 2026. The Company will conduct a conference call at 9:00 a.m. ET on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, to discuss the results. To access the event by telephone, please dial 800-245-3047 (US), 203-518-9765 (INTL), and provide conference ID: MCBQ326 approximately 15 minutes prior to the start time (to allow time for registration). The call will also be broadcast live over the Internet and accessible at MCB Quarterly Results Conference Call and in the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at MCB News. To listen to the live webcast, please visit the site at least 15 minutes prior to the start time to register, download and install any necessary audio software. Net interest income for the third quarter of 2026 was $97.6 million, an increase of $7.2 million, or 7.9%, compared to the prior linked quarter and an increase of $20.3 million, or 26.3%, compared to the prior year period. The net interest margin for the third quarter of 2026 was 4.36%, an increase of 28 basis points compared to the prior linked quarter and an increase of 48 basis points compared to the prior year period. articles.summary: Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. (the “Company”) (NYSE: MCB), the holding company for Metropolitan Commercial Bank, today announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per share on the Company’s common stock (the “Dividend”), an increase of $0.05 from the prior quarterly dividend of $0.35 per share. The Dividend is payable on November 10, 2026 to holders of record of the Company’s common stock at the close of business on October 30, 2026. About Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp., the holding company for Metropolitan Commercial Bank (“MCB”) is a New York City–based, full-service commercial bank serving businesses, institutions, and individuals who value expertise, responsiveness, and long-term partnerships. Since 1999, MCB has built enduring client relationships—many spanning generations—by delivering consistent, relationship-driven banking. articles.summary: Metropolitan Commercial Bank (“MCB” or the “Bank”), a full-service commercial bank headquartered in New York City, is proud to announce that it has been Certified™ by Great Place To Work ® for the second year in a row, reaffirming the Bank's commitment to fostering an exceptional workplace culture where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to succeed. Great Place To Work ® is the global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and the leadership behaviors proven to drive business performance, innovation, and employee satisfaction. This prestigious recognition is based entirely on direct feedback from employees regarding their experience working at MCB.
